Login · Zetalvx Image Lab — SDXL Edition
Images and captions, ready for Zetalvx Image Lab — SDXL Edition.
Delete this dataset and its images?
Add images and captions, then export a ZIP. No GPU required for manual editing.
The trigger may appear at the beginning, at the end or inside the caption. Existing occurrences are not duplicated or moved. Context mode leaves the text untouched.
Caption check: {images} images · {empty} empty · {missing} missing trigger · {repeated} repeated trigger
Word count is not token count. SDXL Training checks tokenizer length separately. A trigger at the end may be truncated if the caption is too long.
Caption text is saved exactly as written. Interface language does not translate captions.
Send dataset images to the Vision endpoint you configured?
Manual editing works without an AI model. For automatic captions, configure your own compatible Vision endpoint. Images are sent only when you start captioning and confirm.
Token stored only on this server with file permissions 0600, not encrypted. Never exported in dataset ZIPs.
Trigger applied without duplicating existing occurrences
Cancellation requested; the current request may finish first
Preview ready. Saving uses this exact PNG.
Preview the new selection before saving
Frame saved to the project library
Upload once, preview the selected frame, then save that exact PNG to the library. The video stays on this server temporarily.
I file sono in un’altra cartella
Apri la fonte e i termini
I verified that the source terms permit my intended use.
Ho verificato che i termini della fonte consentano il mio utilizzo.
Ho verificato i termini dei modelli e dispongo dei diritti per l'uso previsto.
A confirmation does not grant a license or enable external weight downloads.
La conferma non concede una licenza e non abilita download dei pesi esterni.
Downloads continue when the browser closes.
Save without online verification (access is checked on download)
Salva senza verifica online (l’accesso sarà verificato al download)
Prima configurazione · Zetalvx Image Lab — SDXL Edition
Sign in to Zetalvx Image Lab — SDXL Edition
Sign in with the local account created on first launch.
Accedi con l'account locale creato al primo avvio.
Reference, posa e preset di fedeltà.
Select a dedicated SDXL inpainting checkpoint when needed.
Dipingi la maschera e rigenera la selezione.
Base image · target face to replace
Face reference(s) · first image is the primary identity
Choose how you want to work
Keep my prompt + add recipe guidance
Technical presets, saved setups and bindings
Attach model + LoRA to a look button
Auto-save completed variants to project Library
Refine swapped result with selected SDXL checkpoint
Upload an image or a short video
Add LoRAs with individual weights. Available in Simple and Advanced.
Add one or more LoRAs and set each weight. These are used in both Simple and Advanced.
Always available in Simple and Advanced.
Choose a task recipe; optional guidance is added to your prompt.
Apply a task-aware recipe like portrait fidelity, cinematic upgrade or product cleanup.
Choose a workflow when you want hidden recipe guidance, with optional parameter help, on top of your own prompt.
Use when you want the interface to suggest a strategy for the task, not just raw parameters.
Task recipes and hidden prompt guidance
A technical preset changes parameters, not your prompt, seed, resolution or LoRAs.
Choose a preset when you only want a faster technical setup. Prompt, seed, resolution and LoRA stack stay untouched.
Use when you want faster setup of CFG, steps and model-aware controls, without changing the core content idea.
Keep the content idea, but load a technical starting point faster.
InstantID presets adjust identity controls. Prompt, checkpoint, LoRAs, seed and size stay unchanged; Img2Img denoise may change.

Choose a preset to auto-fill the main InstantID controls based on your tested sweet spots. Prompt, checkpoint, LoRA stack, seed and resolution stay untouched unless the preset explicitly needs Img2Img denoise.
Complete presets restore task and selected fields. Style and Technical presets preserve your current task.
Complete presets restore the task and all selected fields. Style and Technical presets can be reused without forcing you into the task they were originally saved from.
Presets store only the components you choose: model, LoRAs, workflow, parameters or prompt.
Complete presets can remember task, model, LoRAs, workflow/style, parameters and prompt. Style and Technical presets only restore the parts you choose.
Complete preset: restores the saved task plus every selected component. Use this for a full repeatable recipe.
Controlled parameter sweeps; prompt, inputs and LoRAs stay fixed.
Keeps your main setup fixed and varies only the selected identity parameters.
Prompt, resolution, LoRAs and input assets stay fixed. The selected profile varies only the parameters that matter most for comparison.
Full model: trained UNet plus frozen base components, stored in models/SDXL/trained.
Complete Diffusers model: trained UNet + frozen base VAE, text encoders and tokenizers. Stored under models/SDXL/trained.
Trained UNet component, ready for inference. Manage it separately from the full model.
Inference-ready UNet component produced by Full SDXL training. Validate, download or delete independently.
Datasets stay in shared/training/datasets across app updates.
Datasets live in shared/training/datasets and survive Zetalvx Image Lab upgrades.
Presets stay in shared/presets/user/image across app updates.
Saved under shared/presets/user/image and kept across Zetalvx Image Lab updates.
Recent results, directly in this studio.
Direct access under the Image Studio page, without going to Library.
First input is primary; extra inputs become references.
First item is primary. Extra uploaded items are appended as references.
Generate, upload an image, or select one from Library.
Generate one, upload a source image, or pick one from Library.
Face Swap preserves the target size and changes detected faces only.
Face Swap keeps the target image size and changes detected faces only.
Face Swap uses the first reference for the largest target face; it does not regenerate the whole image.
True Face Swap replaces the largest face in the base image using the first reference. It does not regenerate the whole picture.
True Face Swap uses the first face reference as source identity and replaces the selected detected face in the base image. Optional SDXL Refine runs only after the deterministic swap.
No pose reference: the primary face provides landmarks.
No pose reference selected; the primary face reference will provide landmarks.
Lower denoise preserves more; higher denoise allows larger changes.
Lower = preserve source/reference more. Higher = allow larger changes.
Img2Img starts from the base image; denoise controls how much can change.
Img2Img uses the Base image as the starting image. Denoise/strength controls how far the result may move away from it: lower preserves more, higher changes more.
Optional refinement uses SDXL after the swap. Keep denoise low to preserve identity.
The swap is performed first. SDXL then runs a low-denoise Img2Img pass to improve skin/detail/integration. Keep denoise low if identity is already good.
This checkpoint is used by InstantID and optional swap refinement. Changing it reloads the pipeline.
This checkpoint drives InstantID and, when enabled, the optional SDXL post-refine after True Face Swap. Changing checkpoint reloads the diffusion pipeline.
Up to four SDXL LoRAs; used by InstantID or optional Face Swap refinement.
Up to 4 SDXL-compatible adapters can be stacked. The same stack is used by InstantID or optional Face Swap SDXL refine.
One GPU job at a time. You can keep adding prompts.
Queue empty. New Identity jobs can be submitted while another one is running.
Painted areas are replaced. Invert also reverses brush and eraser roles.
Painted area = replaced area. Invert swaps the mask and also swaps Brush/Eraser semantics.
Per-job override; the model default is unchanged.
Per-job override. The model's default checkpoint is not changed.
A dedicated inpainting checkpoint and external VAE are optional; blank uses the main checkpoint and included VAE.
Lascia vuoto per usare il checkpoint principale e il VAE incluso. Un modello inpainting o un VAE esterno non è obbligatorio.
LoRA is the recommended starting point. Full SDXL is available in Advanced.
LoRA is the recommended first choice. Full SDXL stays available in Advanced.
Validate, download, recover or delete LoRAs.
Validate, download, recover historical outputs, inspect origin or delete LoRAs.
Images, editing and identity. Choose where to start.
Immagini, ritocchi e identità. Scegli da dove iniziare.
Install, import or use your existing files.
Installa, importa o usa i file che hai già.
Local account only. No external registration.
Serve solo per proteggere l'interfaccia. Nessun account online e nessuna registrazione esterna.
After account setup, choose your SDXL, LoRA and Identity model paths.
Dopo l'account apriremo automaticamente il Setup per scegliere checkpoint SDXL, LoRA e Identity.
Change username or password here, without a terminal.
Modifica utente o password senza usare il terminale.
HTTPS stays enabled. Restart after changing network mode; your account is unchanged.
HTTPS resta attivo. Dopo una modifica alla rete riavvia l’app; l’account rimane lo stesso.
Use your own read-only token with the minimum necessary permissions, not a platform password.
Non chiediamo la password della piattaforma. Usa un token personale in sola lettura, con i soli permessi necessari.
Account access is not a commercial license. Downloads require platform authorization; no access restrictions are bypassed.
Account personale ≠ licenza commerciale. Il token abilita solo i download già autorizzati dalla piattaforma. Nessun aggiramento di accessi o paywall.
Code can be installed. Model weights have separate terms: obtain authorized files and use the indicated folders or existing paths.
Il codice può essere installato. I pesi hanno termini separati: procurati quelli autorizzati per il tuo utilizzo, poi usa le cartelle indicate o collega i file esistenti.
Identity model weights have separate terms. Use only weights licensed for your intended use.
InstantID/InsightFace and face-swap model weights have separate licensing terms; use only weights licensed for your intended use.

Training uses saved captions, not just the trigger field. Prefix, suffix and in-context are all valid. Ensure intended captions include the trigger within the tokenizer limit. Context mode never inserts it automatically.

The trigger may be at the beginning, at the end or inside a caption. Training uses the saved caption text, not just the trigger field. No position is mandatory. Check that the trigger is present in each intended caption and is not lost to tokenizer truncation. Context mode never inserts a missing trigger.
Prepare images in Zetalvx Dataset Studio, export a ZIP and import it here. Captions and trigger placement are preserved.
Prepare and review images in Zetalvx Dataset Studio, export the ZIP and import it here. Captions and trigger placement are preserved.
Manual mode: no hidden workflow. Your prompt and parameters are used as entered.
No hidden style guidance. Manual parameters will be used.
No workflow guidance armed and no preset state active. Best for pure experimentation.
You are in clean/manual mode. Prompt and parameters stay fully under your control until you deliberately apply a workflow or preset.
Simple · Clean · Generate. Manual mode with no workflow or preset armed.
Manual = no hidden guidance. Workflow = task recipe. Preset = technical starting point.
Custom / manual mode. Current values are not changed automatically.
Manual mode: no technical preset selected. Use this when you want to tune CFG, steps and any supported strength controls yourself.
Manual mode: no workflow guidance selected. Use this when you want full prompt freedom or pure technical testing.
Simple · Clean · Generate Image. Manual mode with no workflow or preset armed.
You are in clean/manual mode. No workflow guidance is armed and no preset is active. Current task: {task}.
Simple shows everyday controls; Advanced opens the remaining settings.
Simple shows only everyday controls. Advanced keeps everything else one tap away.
Results are saved in the current project library.
Outputs are saved in the active project library. Advanced FFmpeg controls have been hidden in this SDXL edition.
Resize or convert images, or extract a PNG from video.
Resize or convert images, or grab a frame from a video.
Local PNG extraction requires FFmpeg and ffprobe. No external service receives the video.
Solo estrazione PNG. Il video non viene conservato né inviato a servizi esterni. Richiede FFmpeg e ffprobe installati.
Optional binding: a look can select a model and LoRA. Bindings survive updates.
Useful for things like Anime → preferred model + anime LoRA. The binding remains optional and persistent.
Images and videos from the active project library.
Resolution, seed, steps, CFG and batch
Learning rate, rank, checkpointing and seed
Photogenic Faithful · very similar, a bit cleaner
Expression Freedom · identity strong, expression freer
Natural Reinterpretation · similar but less locked
Running jobs and previous Identity outputs
Swap a face or create new images while keeping the same person.
Tokens stay in an unencrypted local server file (0600, directory 0700), outside projects and presets. They are not returned to the GUI, logged or forwarded to CDNs. Exclude the folder

I token restano sul server Linux, in un file locale non cifrato con permessi 0600 e cartella 0700, fuori da progetti e preset. Non vengono restituiti alla GUI, scritti nei log o inoltrati ai CDN. Escludi la cartella
Paste a Hugging Face, Civitai or direct HTTPS file link. The importer accepts
Incolla il link di un file Hugging Face, Civitai o di un download HTTPS diretto. L’importazione guidata accetta file
You can change username and password in
Puoi cambiare utente e password da
Reload the page and try again
Enter a username and matching passwords of at least 10 characters
Use HTTPS for a remote endpoint

Describe the image or the change you want...
Optional composition image · used as pose when no separate pose image is supplied
{count} media assets available. Ctrl/Cmd-click or tap selections to process multiple compatible files together.
No media yet. Upload one or more files.
Upload files or choose one or more project assets.
Verify the source and confirm to start.
Verifica la fonte e conferma per iniziare.
Download added to queue. You can keep using the app.
Download aggiunto alla coda. Puoi continuare a usare l’app.
Denoise is not used in text-to-image.
Store ip-adapter.bin and ControlNetModel/ containing config.json and diffusion_pytorch_model.safetensors here.
Qui: ip-adapter.bin e ControlNetModel/ con config.json + diffusion_pytorch_model.safetensors.
Extract .onnx files directly here, not inside an extra nested folder.
Estrai la cartella: i file .onnx devono essere direttamente qui, non dentro un’altra antelopev2/.
Estrai i file .onnx direttamente qui. Serve per Face Swap.
Select the inswapper_128.onnx file, not a folder or ZIP.
Qui serve il singolo file inswapper_128.onnx, non una cartella o uno ZIP.
Token saved locally. No platform password is requested.
Token salvato sul server. Nessuna password della piattaforma viene richiesta.
Neutral baseline; add style or LoRA when needed.
Neutral manual-friendly starting point for new generations. Best first pass before adding stronger style or LoRAs.
Sharper realistic generation with slightly stronger adherence and cleaner detail.
More dramatic lighting and polished photographic style.
Final-render style starting point for more dramatic lighting, polish and premium photography language.
Neutral starting point for anime and illustration.
Good neutral base for anime, illustration and stylised character generation without going fully abstract.
Clean product shots for catalogs and advertising.
Optimised starting point for clean product shots, catalog images and ad-ready packshots.
Simple graphics with clearer logos and short text.
Cleaner baseline for logo-like graphics, simple branding panels and short text-heavy visuals.
